description: This file is an HTML webpage that provides a user interface for visualizing database contents, including a sidebar for database and table selection and a main area for displaying data tables with interactive features.
external_files: standard CSS and JavaScript libraries incorporated within the HTML
external_methods: fetchData (fetch API calls to retrieve database info, tables, and data)

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Reloads the database list, providing a refresh animation and resetting the view.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses a database to show its tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches tables for a selected database and displays them in the sidebar.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates the HTML to display a data table with scroll and styling.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual table cell content, handling objects, long strings, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Toggles expanded view of table cell content for long strings or objects.
